items.text: WhatsApp adds new parental controls for Teen Accounts: Here’s what changes
items.article: The WhatsApp announcement comes as governments around the world move to ban or restrict children’s access to social media. WhatsApp on Wednesday, September 30, rolled out new controls for parents to stay on top of who their children are connecting with on the instant messaging platform. The new suite of tools are optional and designed to help parents and teens choose the WhatsApp user experience that is right for them, according to the Meta-owned platform. For instance, parents will be able to choose specific privacy settings on WhatsApp Teen Accounts such as who can see the teen user’s profile photo or add them to groups. Additionally, they can choose to be notified when their teen joins or leaves a group, or when a group their teen is in adds new members. They will further be able to choose how their teen can use Channels, whose Status updates they can see, and who can see theirs. In order to change these settings, teens will need their parent’s approval via a PIN also set by the parents. The teen-focused safety protections also extend to Meta AI, with an option for parents to choose between the default 13+ setting and a stricter ‘Limited Content’ option. items.article: A new study suggests that creatine could support muscle growth, even without exercise. You could be getting jacked from the couch after all. Or, more accurately, you could see some muscle gains without traditional exercise — at least, according to a new study that highlights one popular supplement as a potential contributor. In a 12-week study published in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition, adults ages 45 to 65 who took creatine increased their lean tissue and strength, even without following a structured exercise program. Participants who took creatine while exercising and following a calorie-reduced diet experienced even greater benefits, including increased fat loss. That’s encouraging news, especially for Gen Xers looking for an extra boost. Fortunately, there are several popular creatine brands available online — including Optimum Nutrition , Thorne and Transparent Labs — some of which retail for up to $80 per bottle. items.key: ai:the secret to cooking with stainless steel (it's all about 'terminator 2')
items.text: The secret to cooking with stainless steel (it’s all about ‘Terminator 2’)
items.article: Before I worked in restaurants, I had a lot of trouble with stainless steel pans. See more from the L.A. Times in Google Search. Set us as preferred My fish would stick, my eggs wouldn’t flip, and I frequently found myself turning to nonstick pans instead (don’t worry, I haven’t had any effects from PFAs, beyond a slight softening of the teeth). I know I’m not alone, and as I’m sure many of you have, I turned to social media for help. There, I found an unending sea of (mostly) bearded men promising me the world: a simple technique that would ensure my fried eggs slid effortlessly across my pan like roller skates on Vaseline. The person in the video would sprinkle some water onto a hot skillet, and it would magically transform into translucent orbs that glided wobbly (and easily) across the pan’s seemingly nonstick surface. For some reason I couldn’t totally understand, passing the water droplet test seemed to be the secret to cooking in a stainless steel pan. It wasn’t until I reached the grill station on the line at Chez Panisse that stainless steel cookery really clicked.

items.article: NBEMS has said that the individual scorecards and question-wise answer and response details will be available on or after October 1, 2026. After declaring the NEET PG 2026 results, the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is now set to make individual scorecards available to candidates. Those who appeared for the NEET PG exam can access their scorecards through the official NBEMS website, natboard.edu.in. NBEMS has said that the individual scorecards and question-wise answer and response details will be available on or after October 1, 2026. The NEET PG scorecard is an important document for the counselling and admission process. Candidates should download and preserve it for use during counselling and admission to postgraduate medical courses. There is often confusion among candidates about the difference between the NEET PG result PDF and the individual scorecard. The result PDF primarily contains candidates’ roll numbers, scores and qualifying status, while the individual scorecard provides candidate-specific details, including rank and other examination information. items.article: The issue of who should lead the opposition against the BJP and Prime Minister Narendra Modi has remained a point of discussion since the formation of the INDIA bloc in 2023. The INDIA bloc’s internal differences over leadership and the prime ministerial face for the 2029 Lok Sabha election came into focus again on Wednesday after a high-profile meeting of opposition parties in New Delhi. The meeting was convened to discuss the alliance’s future strategy over issues concerning the Election Commission and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. While the opposition parties sought to project a united front, questions about the alliance’s leadership emerged soon after the meeting when Trinamool Congress chief Mamata Banerjee was asked whether Congress leader Rahul Gandhi would be the opposition’s prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 Lok Sabha elections. Banerjee did not give a direct answer. items.text: ‘Punjab For Punjabis’: Can Amritpal’s Waris Punjab De Woo Young Sons Of Soil, Challenge Congress Ahead Of Polls?
items.article: Amritpal Singh's Waris Punjab De: The question now is whether that message can translate into votes and whether the new kid on the block can actually make it to power The road to power is rocky. But Waris Punjab De believes it can turn that road into a political highway. The fledgling outfit is the new kid on Punjab’s political block. Its founder, Amritpal Singh, has been lodged in an Assam jail for over three years and faces charges under the National Security Act. Critics see Waris Punjab De as a panthic and hardline organisation. But in several pockets of the state, especially among young voters, its appeal appears to be growing. Its message is simple: Punjab for Punjabis. For a new generation of Punjabi youth, the demand is not just about identity. It is about jobs, opportunity and a sense of ownership over their own state. Students at Punjabi University in Patiala told News18: “If we are good enough to become presidents of the World Bank, owners of big companies and hold top positions, then why should we be forced to be second-class citizens in our own state? Factories set up in Punjab hire people from outside. No one has bothered to address this."
